correctness.rationale: For u with ordered absolute coordinates a≥b≥c, solving plane x1=-(bx2+cx3)/a gives Jacobian 1/a and forbidden corners of total projected area (b+c-a)_+²/(bc), hence A=4/a-(b+c-a)_+²/(abc). Near six axis normals this is 4/a and spherical cap probability exactly 3(1-4/(4+ε)). Near twelve face diagonal normals tangent deficit is 4sqrt(2)|t|+2(|s|-sqrt(2)|t|)_+²/|s| plus o(radius). Integrating the degree-one sublevel yields quadrant J=(4+π)/(64sqrt2), coefficient 12*4J/(4π)=3(4+π)/(16πsqrt2). Independently evaluated tangent ratios near 1 (.99967,.99992,.999985) and constant .30139183075. Global extrema used from prior cube section theory; no claim of full CDF.
